mcqs.question: Who was the first Governor-General of Pakistan after independence in 1947?
mcqs.explanation: Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah was sworn in as the first Governor-General of Pakistan on August 15, 1947, administered by Chief Justice Mian Abdul Rashid.
mcqs.reference: FPSC Past Papers / Constitutional History of Pakistan
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: The Objectives Resolution was officially passed by the Constituent Assembly of Pakistan on:
mcqs.explanation: The Objectives Resolution was moved by Prime Minister Liaquat Ali Khan on 7 March 1949 and approved by the Constituent Assembly on 12 March 1949.
mcqs.reference: PPSC Tehsildar & FPSC Lecturer Exam Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: The historic Indus Waters Treaty was signed between Pakistan and India in which year?
mcqs.explanation: The Indus Waters Treaty was signed in Karachi on 19 September 1960 by Field Marshal Ayub Khan and Indian PM Jawaharlal Nehru with World Bank mediation.
mcqs.reference: FPSC Inspector Investigation & CSS Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Under which Constitution was Pakistan first proclaimed as an "Islamic Republic"?
mcqs.explanation: The 1956 Constitution of Pakistan was promulgated on 23 March 1956 and officially designated Pakistan as the "Islamic Republic of Pakistan".
mcqs.reference: PPSC Assistant Director & CSS Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Which constitutional amendment in Pakistan abolished the Concurrent List and granted extensive provincial autonomy?
mcqs.explanation: The 18th Constitutional Amendment passed in April 2010 devolved powers to the provinces, removed the Concurrent List, and renamed NWFP to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Who was the first Prime Minister of Pakistan?
mcqs.explanation: Nawabzada Liaquat Ali Khan served as Pakistan’s first Prime Minister from 15 August 1947 until his assassination in Company Bagh, Rawalpindi on 16 October 1951.
mcqs.reference: FPSC / PPSC General Knowledge Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: The historic Pakistan Resolution (Lahore Resolution) on 23rd March 1940 was presented by:
mcqs.explanation: The Lahore Resolution was drafted and formally moved by the Premier of Bengal, A.K. Fazlul Huq (Sher-e-Bangla), during the annual All-India Muslim League session at Minto Park.
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: The Simla Agreement between Pakistan and India was signed on July 2, 1972 by Zulfikar Ali Bhutto and:
mcqs.explanation: The Simla Agreement was signed on July 2, 1972 in Himachal Pradesh, India between Pakistani President Z.A. Bhutto and Indian PM Indira Gandhi to resolve postwar issues.
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Which mountain pass connects Pakistan with China through the Karakoram Highway?
mcqs.explanation: The Khunjerab Pass at an elevation of 4,693 meters (15,397 ft) connects Gilgit-Baltistan of Pakistan with Xinjiang region of China.
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: The first national census of Pakistan was conducted in which year?
mcqs.explanation: Pakistan’s first official population census was conducted in 1951, recording a total population of 75.8 million across East and West Pakistan.
mcqs.reference: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics / FPSC Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Pakistan Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Who is the current Prime Minister of Pakistan?
mcqs.explanation: Mian Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif took oath as the 24th Prime Minister of Pakistan on March 4, 2024 following the general elections held on February 8, 2024.
mcqs.reference: Prime Minister Office Pakistan / National Assembly Records
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Who is the current President of Pakistan?
mcqs.explanation: Asif Ali Zardari took oath as the 14th President of Pakistan on March 10, 2024. He previously served as President from 2008 to 2013.
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Who took oath as the 30th Chief Justice of Pakistan in October 2024?
mcqs.explanation: Justice Yahya Afridi was appointed by the Special Parliamentary Committee under the 26th Amendment and took oath as the 30th Chief Justice of Pakistan on October 26, 2024.
mcqs.reference: Supreme Court of Pakistan / Current Affairs 2024-2026
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Which city hosted the 23rd SCO Council of Heads of Government summit in October 2024?
mcqs.explanation: Pakistan hosted the 23rd Council of Heads of Government (CHG) of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) in Islamabad on 15-16 October 2024.
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: The 26th Constitutional Amendment enacted in Pakistan in October 2024 is primarily related to:
mcqs.explanation: The 26th Constitutional Amendment introduced constitutional benches in Supreme Court and High Courts and created a 12-member parliamentary committee for CJP appointment.
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Which country officially joined NATO as its 32nd member state in March 2024?
mcqs.explanation: Sweden officially became the 32nd member of NATO on 7 March 2024, ending over two centuries of official military neutrality.
mcqs.reference: NATO Official Records / International Current Affairs
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Pakistan was elected as a non-permanent member of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) for which term?
mcqs.explanation: Pakistan secured an overwhelming 182 votes in the UN General Assembly in June 2024 to win a non-permanent seat on the UN Security Council for the two-year term 2025–2026.
mcqs.reference: UN General Assembly Official Press / MOFA
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: The United Nations Climate Change Conference COP29 in November 2024 was hosted by which city?
mcqs.explanation: COP29 was held in Baku, Azerbaijan in November 2024 with key focus on establishing the New Collective Quantified Goal (NCQG) on climate finance.
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Which team won the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup held in the USA and West Indies in June 2024?
mcqs.explanation: India defeated South Africa by 7 runs in the final at Kensington Oval, Barbados on 29 June 2024 to lift their second T20 World Cup title.
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Who is the current Secretary-General of the United Nations?
mcqs.explanation: António Guterres of Portugal is the 9th Secretary-General of the United Nations, serving his second five-year term since January 2017.
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: The deep-sea port of Gwadar in Pakistan is strategically situated along the coastline of which sea?
mcqs.explanation: Gwadar Port is situated on the shores of the Arabian Sea in Balochistan province near the mouth of the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz.
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: What is the estimated total route length of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) from Kashgar to Gwadar?
mcqs.explanation: The CPEC transportation corridor spans roughly 3,000 kilometers from Kashgar in Xinjiang, China to the warm-water port of Gwadar in Pakistan.
mcqs.subject: Current Affairs
mcqs.author: Admin Examination Board

mcqs.question: Choose the correct preposition: "He is senior ______ me in service and experience."
mcqs.explanation: Adjectives derived from Latin ending in -ior (senior, junior, superior, inferior, prior, anterior, posterior) are followed by "to", not "than".
mcqs.reference: PPSC & FPSC Most Repeated Preposition Question Bank
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: What is the exact SYNONYM of the word "CANDID"?
mcqs.explanation: "Candid" means truthful, straightforward, and sincere in speech; hence "Frank" is the direct synonym.
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: What is the ANTONYM of the word "EPHEMERAL"?
mcqs.explanation: "Ephemeral" means lasting for a very short time. Its antonym is "Permanent" or "Eternal".
mcqs.reference: CSS English Precis & Composition Past Papers
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: Choose the correct preposition: "She is proficient ______ spoken English and French."
mcqs.explanation: The adjective "proficient" is correctly followed by the preposition "in" (proficient in a language or subject).
mcqs.reference: Oxford Advanced Learner Dictionary / FPSC English
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: Identify the word with the CORRECT spelling:
mcqs.explanation: The correct spelling is "Bureaucracy" (B-U-R-E-A-U-C-R-A-C-Y), derived from French bureau (desk) + Greek kratos (rule).
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: What is the meaning of the idiom: "To burn the midnight oil"?

options.text: To work or study late into the night

mcqs.explanation: "To burn the midnight oil" means to read, study, or work hard late into the night.
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: Change the voice: "The police caught the thief."

options.text: The thief has been caught by the police.
The thief was caught by the police.
The thief had been caught by the police.
The thief was being caught by the police.

mcqs.explanation: Simple past tense active voice (caught) changes into "was/were + past participle" (was caught) in passive voice.
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: Fill in the blank: "The security guard prevented him ______ entering the premises."
mcqs.explanation: The verb "prevent" takes the preposition "from" followed by a gerund (-ing form): prevent someone from doing something.
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: What is the ANTONYM of the word "METICULOUS"?
mcqs.explanation: "Meticulous" means showing great attention to detail and precision. Its antonym is "Careless" or "Sloppy".
mcqs.reference: CSS Competitive Exam English Past Papers
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: What is the SYNONYM of the word "UBIQUITOUS"?
mcqs.explanation: "Ubiquitous" means present, appearing, or found everywhere at the same time (omnipresent).
mcqs.subject: English MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Hassan Raza

mcqs.question: What does CPU stand for in computer systems?
mcqs.explanation: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit, often described as the brain of the computer that executes software instructions.
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: Which keyboard shortcut key is used to Undo the last action in MS Word and Excel?
mcqs.explanation: Ctrl + Z is the universal shortcut to Undo an action, while Ctrl + Y is used to Redo an action.
mcqs.reference: MS Office Shortcut Keys / FPSC Inspector Exam
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: What is the default port number used by the secure HTTPS web protocol?
mcqs.explanation: HTTPS (HTTP Secure) runs over port 443 using SSL/TLS encryption, whereas unencrypted HTTP uses port 80.
mcqs.reference: Networking Fundamentals / FPSC IT Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: Which type of computer memory is non-volatile and retains instructions even when power is turned off?
mcqs.explanation: ROM (Read-Only Memory) is non-volatile storage containing the firmware and bootstrap loader that remains intact without electrical power.
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: In relational database management systems (RDBMS), what uniquely identifies each row in a table?
mcqs.explanation: A Primary Key is a column or set of columns whose values uniquely identify every record in a table, without permitting NULL values.
mcqs.reference: Database Management Systems / PPSC Lecturer CS
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: How many bits are there in an IPv4 (Internet Protocol version 4) address?
mcqs.explanation: An IPv4 address consists of 32 bits divided into four 8-bit octets (e.g. 192.168.1.1). IPv6 addresses consist of 128 bits.
mcqs.reference: Computer Networking / PPSC Data Entry Operator
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: Which layer of the standard OSI model is responsible for reliable end-to-end transport and flow control?
mcqs.explanation: The Transport Layer (Layer 4) handles end-to-end communication, error recovery, segmentation, and flow control using protocols like TCP and UDP.
mcqs.reference: OSI Reference Model / FPSC Computer Science
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: In Python programming, which of the following standard data types is immutable (cannot be modified after creation)?
mcqs.explanation: In Python, Tuples and Strings are immutable types. Lists, Dictionaries, and Sets can be altered dynamically (mutable).
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: What does SQL stand for in computer databases?
mcqs.explanation: SQL stands for Structured Query Language, the standardized domain-specific language for managing relational databases.
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: Which protocol is primarily used for sending outgoing email messages across the Internet?
mcqs.explanation: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used for sending emails. POP3 and IMAP are protocols used for retrieving/downloading emails.
mcqs.reference: FPSC Computer Science Screening Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Computer Science
mcqs.author: Engr. Bilal Khan

mcqs.question: How many total Surahs (chapters) are there in the Holy Quran?
mcqs.explanation: The Holy Quran consists of 114 Surahs, with 86 classified as Makki and 28 classified as Madani.
mcqs.reference: Islamic Studies / FPSC & PPSC Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: Which Surah of the Holy Quran is known as the "Heart of the Quran" (Qalb-ul-Quran)?
mcqs.explanation: Surah Yaseen (the 36th Surah) is described in a well-known Hadith as the Heart of the Quran.
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: In which year of Hijrah did the decisive Battle of Badr take place?
mcqs.explanation: The Battle of Badr took place on 17 Ramadan 2 A.H. (624 CE) in which 313 Muslims achieved historic victory over 1000 Quraysh warriors.
mcqs.reference: Seerah Ibn Hisham / PPSC Islamiat Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: Who was appointed as the first Caliph of Islam after the demise of the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
mcqs.explanation: Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique (R.A.) was chosen as the first Rightly Guided Caliph (Khilafat-e-Rashida) in 11 A.H. (632 CE).
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: Which Surah of the Holy Quran does not begin with "Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim"?
mcqs.explanation: Surah At-Tawbah (Surah Bara’at, 9th Surah) does not start with Bismillah, whereas Surah An-Naml contains Bismillah twice.
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: What is the Nisab (minimum threshold) of Zakat on gold in Islamic Jurisprudence?
mcqs.explanation: The Nisab of Zakat for gold is 7.5 tolas (approx. 87.48 grams), whereas for silver it is 52.5 tolas (approx. 612.36 grams).
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: The historic Treaty of Hudaibiyah was signed between Muslims and Quraysh in which year of Hijrah?
mcqs.explanation: The Treaty of Hudaibiyah was formulated in Dhu al-Qadah 6 A.H. (628 CE), described in Surah Al-Fath as a "Clear Victory" (Fath-an-Mubeena).
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: How many Takbeers are recited in Salat al-Janazah (Funeral Prayer)?
mcqs.explanation: Salat al-Janazah consists of 4 Takbeers without any Ruku or Sujood according to Sunnah.
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: Which Prophet of Allah is renowned with the title "Jadd-ul-Anbiya" (Father of the Prophets)?
mcqs.explanation: Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S.) is titled "Jadd-ul-Anbiya" and "Khalilullah" because many great Prophets descended from his lineage through Hazrat Ismail (A.S.) and Hazrat Ishaq (A.S.).
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: Under whose Caliphate was the official compilation and standardization of the Quranic Mushaf completed and copies dispatched to provinces?
mcqs.explanation: Hazrat Usman Ghani (R.A.) standardized the pronunciation and script based on the Quraish dialect, earning him the title "Jami-ul-Quran".
mcqs.subject: Islamic Studies
mcqs.author: Mufti Saeed Ahmed

mcqs.question: Which gas is the most abundant by volume in Earth’s atmosphere?
mcqs.explanation: Nitrogen gas accounts for approximately 78.08% of Earth’s atmosphere, followed by Oxygen at around 20.95% and Argon at 0.93%.
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: Deficiency of Vitamin C in the human diet causes which disease?
mcqs.explanation: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) deficiency leads to Scurvy, characterized by bleeding gums and poor wound healing. Vitamin D causes Rickets, Vitamin B1 causes Beriberi, and Vitamin A causes Night Blindness.
mcqs.reference: CSS General Science & Ability Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: Which vital organs in the human body are responsible for filtering metabolic waste products from blood to form urine?
mcqs.explanation: The kidneys filter blood through millions of tiny functional units called nephrons, maintaining fluid and electrolyte balance.
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: What is the chemical name and formula of common table salt?
mcqs.explanation: Table salt is Sodium Chloride with the chemical formula NaCl, composed of sodium and chlorine ions.
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: A "Light Year" is a scientific unit used to measure:
mcqs.explanation: A light-year is the distance that light travels through a vacuum in one Julian year (approx. 9.46 trillion kilometers). It measures astronomical distance.
mcqs.reference: PPSC Most Repeated Everyday Science Questions
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: Which planet in our solar system is widely known as the "Red Planet"?
mcqs.explanation: Mars is known as the Red Planet because its surface is rich in iron oxide (rust), which gives it a reddish appearance.
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: What is the standard normal human body temperature in degrees Celsius (°C)?
mcqs.explanation: Normal human body core temperature is approximately 37°C (corresponding to 98.6°F in Fahrenheit).
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: Sound waves are mechanical waves that cannot propagate through:
mcqs.explanation: Sound requires a physical material medium (solid, liquid, or gas) to travel and therefore cannot travel through a vacuum.
mcqs.reference: Physics Basics / FPSC Inspector Past Paper
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: Which endocrine gland in the human body is referred to as the "Master Gland"?
mcqs.explanation: The pituitary gland at the base of the brain is termed the Master Gland because its hormones regulate the activity of other endocrine glands.
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: Photosynthesis in plant cells occurs inside which microscopic cellular organelle?
mcqs.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll pigments that capture sunlight energy to convert CO2 and water into glucose and oxygen.
mcqs.subject: Everyday Science
mcqs.author: Dr. Ayesha Malik

mcqs.question: What is the official capital city of Turkey?
mcqs.explanation: Ankara has been the capital city of Turkey since 1923, following the establishment of the Republic by Mustafa Kemal Atatürk. Istanbul is the largest city.
mcqs.reference: World Capitals / PPSC & FPSC General Knowledge
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: What is the official currency of Japan?
mcqs.explanation: The Japanese Yen (¥) is the official currency of Japan, and one of the world’s major reserve currencies.
mcqs.reference: Currencies of the World / FPSC Screening
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: Which is the deepest oceanic trench in the world?
mcqs.explanation: The Mariana Trench in the western Pacific Ocean reaches a maximum known depth of approximately 10,994 meters (36,070 ft) at Challenger Deep.
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: The headquarters of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) is located in which city?
mcqs.explanation: The ICJ (the principal judicial organ of the UN) is located in the Peace Palace at The Hague, Netherlands.
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: Which is the largest continent in the world by both surface land area and total population?
mcqs.explanation: Asia is the Earth’s largest and most populous continent, covering roughly 30% of Earth’s land area and hosting over 4.7 billion people.
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: The famous Suez Canal connects which two bodies of water?
mcqs.explanation: The Suez Canal in Egypt connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea, offering the shortest maritime trade route between Europe and Asia.
mcqs.reference: Strategic Straits & Canals / CSS Past Papers
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: Mount Everest, the highest mountain peak above sea level on Earth, is situated on the border of Nepal and:
mcqs.explanation: Mount Everest (8,848.86 m) lies in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas on the international border between Nepal and Tibet Autonomous Region of China.
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: Which river is traditionally recognized as the longest river in the world?
mcqs.explanation: The Nile River in northeastern Africa flows for approximately 6,650 kilometers (4,132 miles), historically classified as the longest river on Earth.
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: The prestigious Nobel Prize is awarded annually in how many distinct categories?
mcqs.explanation: Nobel Prizes are awarded in 6 categories: Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine, Literature, Peace, and Economic Sciences (added in 1968).
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: The headquarters of the United Nations (UN) is situated in which city?
mcqs.explanation: The official headquarters complex of the United Nations has been located in Manhattan, New York City, USA since 1952.
mcqs.reference: UN Charter / PPSC Assistant Director Exam
mcqs.subject: General Knowledge
mcqs.author: Prof. Tariq Mahmood

mcqs.question: If 15% of a certain number is 45, what is the total number?
mcqs.explanation: Let the number be x. 0.15 * x = 45 => x = 45 / 0.15 = 300.
mcqs.reference: Basic Arithmetic / FPSC & PPSC Quantitative Ability
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: Solve for x in the linear algebraic equation: 3x + 15 = 45.
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: The average of 5 numbers is 20. If one number is excluded, the average of the remaining 4 numbers becomes 18. What was the excluded number?
mcqs.explanation: Sum of 5 numbers = 5 * 20 = 100. Sum of 4 numbers = 4 * 18 = 72. Excluded number = 100 - 72 = 28.
mcqs.reference: Averages & Word Problems / FPSC Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: A high-speed train travels 360 km in 4 hours. What is its speed converted into meters per second (m/s)?
mcqs.explanation: Speed in km/h = 360 / 4 = 90 km/h. To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18: 90 * (5/18) = 25 m/s.
mcqs.reference: Speed Time Distance / NTS & GAT Quantitative
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: What is the ratio of 45 minutes to 3 hours expressed in its simplest reduced form?
mcqs.explanation: 3 hours = 3 * 60 = 180 minutes. Ratio = 45 / 180 = 1 / 4, which is 1 : 4.
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: A shopkeeper purchases an item for Rs. 800 and sells it for Rs. 1,000. What is his profit percentage?
mcqs.explanation: Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price = 1000 - 800 = Rs. 200. Profit % = (200 / 800) * 100 = 25%.
mcqs.reference: Profit and Loss / FPSC Custom Inspector Exam
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: If 12 workers can build a wall in 8 days, how many days will it take for 16 workers to complete the same wall working at the same pace?
mcqs.explanation: Total man-days required = 12 * 8 = 96 man-days. Days required by 16 workers = 96 / 16 = 6 days.
mcqs.reference: Time and Work / PPSC & CSS Ability Exam
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: In Euclidean geometry, what is the sum of all interior angles of any triangle?
mcqs.explanation: The sum of the three interior angles of any triangle is always strictly equal to 180 degrees (π radians).
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: What is the next number in the numerical series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ______?
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: Find the circumference of a circle whose radius is 7 cm (taking π = 22/7):
mcqs.explanation: Circumference = 2 * π * r = 2 * (22/7) * 7 = 44 cm. (Note: 154 cm² is the area = π * r²).
mcqs.subject: Mathematics
mcqs.author: Prof. Zubair Qureshi

mcqs.question: The Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC) was reconstituted under the FPSC Ordinance in which year?
mcqs.explanation: The Federal Public Service Commission was reconstituted under the FPSC Ordinance 1977 to conduct recruitment to the All Pakistan Services and civil posts.
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: In Punjab Public Service Commission (PPSC) competitive examinations, what is generally the minimum passing percentage required in each subject?
mcqs.explanation: According to PPSC rules, candidates must secure at least 40% marks in each individual paper and a 50% aggregate in written examinations.
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: Under the Pakistan Penal Code (PPC), which section prescribes the punishment for Murder (Qatl-i-Amd)?
mcqs.explanation: Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code 1860 provides the punishment for Qatl-i-Amd (intentional murder) as death (qisas) or imprisonment for life.
mcqs.reference: Pakistan Penal Code 1860 / PPSC Sub-Inspector & AD Law
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: The National Accountability Bureau (NAB) was established in Pakistan under the NAB Ordinance of:
mcqs.explanation: NAB was created on 16 November 1999 through the National Accountability Bureau Ordinance (Ordinance No. XVIII of 1999).
mcqs.reference: NAB Ordinance 1999 / FPSC Inspector NAB Exam
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: Under the Constitution of Pakistan, which independent body is mandated to organize and conduct national and provincial elections?
mcqs.explanation: Article 218 of the 1973 Constitution establishes the Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) to organize and conduct honest, just, and fair elections.
mcqs.reference: Constitution of Pakistan 1973 / FPSC Assistant Director
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: In which year was the Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) enacted under the FIA Act in Pakistan?
mcqs.explanation: The FIA was formally constituted under the Federal Investigation Agency Act 1974 (Act No. VIII of 1975) enacted in late 1974.
mcqs.reference: FIA Act 1974 / FPSC Inspector Investigation Syllabus
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: What is the total sanctioned strength of the Senate of Pakistan after the implementation of the 25th Constitutional Amendment (FATA merger)?
mcqs.explanation: Following the 25th Amendment and retirement of former FATA senators in 2021 and 2024, the permanent strength of the Senate is reduced from 104 to 96.
mcqs.reference: Senate of Pakistan Official / PPSC Lecturer Civics
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: Which premier occupational group of Central Superior Services manages executive district administration across Pakistan?
mcqs.explanation: Pakistan Administrative Service (PAS, formerly DMG) is the elite administrative cadre responsible for field administration (Assistant Commissioner, Deputy Commissioner, Secretary).
mcqs.reference: Civil Services Rules / FPSC CSS Guidelines
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: In the PPSC Tehsildar and Naib Tehsildar examinations, Land Revenue law is governed under which primary statute?
mcqs.explanation: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act 1967 (Act XVII of 1967) is the primary governing legislation tested in PPSC Tehsildar examinations.
mcqs.reference: Land Revenue Act 1967 / PPSC Tehsildar Past Papers
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: Who is the constitutional authority that appoints the Chairman and Members of the Federal Public Service Commission?
mcqs.explanation: Under Section 3 of the FPSC Ordinance 1977, the Chairman and Members of the Commission are appointed by the President of Pakistan on the advice of the Prime Minister.
mcqs.subject: FPSC & PPSC Preparation
mcqs.author: Advocate Malik Shahbaz

mcqs.question: In the National Testing Service (NTS) GAT General test, what percentage of questions is allocated to Analytical Reasoning?
mcqs.explanation: In NTS GAT General, the standard pattern consists of 35% Verbal, 35% Quantitative, and 30% Analytical Reasoning.
mcqs.reference: NTS GAT General Official Test Pattern
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: Complete the verbal analogy: CLOTH : WEAVER :: BREAD : ?
mcqs.explanation: A Weaver makes Cloth; similarly, a Baker bakes Bread (Product : Producer relationship).
mcqs.reference: NTS Verbal Analogies / GAT & NAT Preparation
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: Logical deduction: If Ali is taller than Bilal, and Bilal is taller than Daniyal, who is the shortest among them?
mcqs.explanation: Since Ali > Bilal and Bilal > Daniyal, by transitive order Ali > Bilal > Daniyal. Daniyal is the shortest.
mcqs.reference: Analytical Reasoning Basics / NTS Past Papers
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: If a solid geometric cube has a total volume of 64 cm³, what is the length of each of its edges?
mcqs.explanation: Volume of cube = edge³ = a³. Since a³ = 64 => a = ³√64 = 4 cm.
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: Letter coding: In a certain code, CAT is coded as 3120 (C=3, A=1, T=20). Following the same rule, how will DOG be coded?
mcqs.explanation: Each letter is assigned its numerical position in the English alphabet: D = 4, O = 15, G = 7 => 4157.
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: Direction test: A traveler walks 5 km North, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right and walks 5 km. In which direction is he from his starting point?
mcqs.explanation: Walking 5 km North, turning right (East) 3 km, then turning right (South) 5 km returns his vertical displacement to zero, leaving him exactly 3 km East of origin.
mcqs.reference: Direction Sense Reasoning / NTS Educators Test
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: Choose the correct synonym for the word "PRUDENT" used in NTS verbal test:
mcqs.explanation: "Prudent" means acting with or showing care and thought for the future; synonyms include Wise, Sagacious, and Cautious.
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: The perimeter of a rectangle is 60 cm and its length is 20 cm. What is its breadth (width)?
mcqs.explanation: Perimeter = 2 * (length + width) => 60 = 2 * (20 + width) => 30 = 20 + width => width = 10 cm.
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: If 4 shirts cost Rs. 2,400, what will be the total cost of 7 such shirts at the identical rate?
mcqs.explanation: Cost of 1 shirt = 2400 / 4 = Rs. 600. Cost of 7 shirts = 7 * 600 = Rs. 4,200.
mcqs.reference: Unitary Method / PTS Junior Clerk Past Paper
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: Find the odd one out from the given list: Car, Bus, Train, Aeroplane, Boat.
mcqs.explanation: Train is the only transport in this group that strictly requires and runs exclusively upon dedicated railway tracks.
mcqs.subject: NTS / OTS / PTS Tests
mcqs.author: Engr. Kamran Tariq

mcqs.question: How many compulsory subjects and total marks are there in the CSS written competitive examination?
mcqs.explanation: The CSS written examination includes 6 compulsory subjects (100 marks each = 600 marks) and optional subjects worth 600 marks (Total written = 1200 marks).
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: What is the total marks allocated for the complete CSS Competitive Examination (Written + Medical/Psychological + Viva Voce)?
mcqs.explanation: The CSS exam total is 1500 marks: 1200 marks for the written examination and 300 marks for the Viva Voce (interview).
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: The theoretical concept of "Balance of Power" is the foundation of which major school of thought in International Relations?
mcqs.explanation: Balance of Power is a central tenet of Realism, asserting that international stability is preserved when military power is distributed so that no single state dominates.
mcqs.reference: International Relations / CSS IR Paper I
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: Which article of the 1973 Constitution of Pakistan defines and prescribes severe penalty for "High Treason"?
mcqs.explanation: Article 6 of the Constitution of Pakistan defines High Treason as abrogating, subverting, or suspending the Constitution by use of force or unconstitutional means.
mcqs.reference: Constitution of Pakistan 1973 / CSS Constitutional Law
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: What is the mandatory minimum qualifying percentage in the CSS MCQ-based Preliminary Test (MPT)?
mcqs.explanation: The CSS MPT screening test carries 200 marks and candidates must obtain a minimum of 33% (66 marks) to qualify for the main written examination.
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: Who authored the landmark foundational book "Politics Among Nations: The Struggle for Power and Peace" published in 1948?
mcqs.explanation: Hans J. Morgenthau authored "Politics Among Nations", introducing the Six Principles of Political Realism.
mcqs.reference: Classical Political Theory / CSS Political Science
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: Fundamental Rights in the 1973 Constitution of Pakistan are contained in which range of Articles?
mcqs.explanation: Part II, Chapter 1 of the Constitution (Articles 8 through 28) guarantees Fundamental Rights to citizens, including security of person, liberty, and equality.
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: Which international organization publishes the annual Human Development Report and Human Development Index (HDI)?
mcqs.explanation: The Human Development Index (HDI) was devised by Pakistani economist Mahbub ul Haq and Indian economist Amartya Sen and is published annually by the UNDP.
mcqs.reference: Global Economic Reports / CSS Economics & Current Affairs
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: The Peace of Westphalia (1648) is globally recognized for establishing which foundational norm in modern International Law and Relations?
mcqs.explanation: The Treaties of Westphalia in 1648 ended the Thirty Years’ War and created the modern nation-state system based on territorial integrity and sovereignty.
mcqs.reference: CSS International Relations & History of USA
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: In the Punjab Provincial Management Service (PMS) exam, the total marks for optional subjects is:
mcqs.explanation: In PMS Punjab, candidates choose 3 optional subjects carrying 200 marks each (total 600 optional marks + 600 compulsory marks = 1200 marks).
mcqs.subject: CSS & PMS Exams
mcqs.author: Dr. Shaharyar Khan (PAS)

mcqs.question: What is the SI base unit of electric current?
mcqs.explanation: The SI unit of electric current is the Ampere (symbol: A). Coulomb is unit of charge, Volt is potential difference, and Watt is power.
mcqs.reference: SI Units / FPSC Lecturer Physics & General Science
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: Newton’s First Law of Motion is also known as the Law of:
mcqs.explanation: Newton’s First Law states that a body remains at rest or in uniform straight motion unless acted upon by a net external force; hence it is called the Law of Inertia.
mcqs.reference: Classical Mechanics / PPSC Physics Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: What is the approximate standard value of acceleration due to gravity (g) at sea level on Earth?
mcqs.explanation: The standard gravitational acceleration near Earth’s surface is approximately 9.80665 m/s² (commonly taken as 9.8 m/s²).
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: Which type of optical mirror is fitted in automobiles as a rear-view mirror because it provides a wider field of view?
mcqs.explanation: Convex mirrors always produce an erect, virtual, and diminished image, giving drivers a much wider panoramic rear field of view.
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: What is the speed of light in a vacuum?
mcqs.explanation: The speed of light in vacuum (c) is precisely 299,792,458 m/s, approximately 3 × 10⁸ meters per second (300,000 km/s).
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: The apparent twinkling of stars in the night sky is primarily caused by which optical phenomenon?
mcqs.explanation: Starlight passes through different layers of Earth’s atmosphere with fluctuating temperatures and optical densities, continuously refracting the rays and causing twinkling.
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: Which electromagnetic spectrum wave possesses the shortest wavelength and the highest photon frequency and energy?
mcqs.explanation: Gamma rays have wavelengths shorter than 10 picometers and exhibit the highest frequencies and penetrative photon energy in the electromagnetic spectrum.
mcqs.reference: Modern Physics / FPSC Lecturer Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: What is the standard SI unit of electrical resistance?
mcqs.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in Ohms (symbol: Ω), named after German physicist Georg Simon Ohm.
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: According to Ohm’s Law, what is the exact mathematical equation relating Voltage (V), Current (I), and Resistance (R)?
mcqs.explanation: Ohm’s Law states that current through a conductor is directly proportional to voltage across it: V = IR.
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: An electrical power transformer operates primarily on which electromagnetic principle?
mcqs.explanation: Transformers function based on Faraday’s Law of electromagnetic induction and Mutual Induction between two inductive coils (primary and secondary).
mcqs.subject: Physics MCQs
mcqs.author: Prof. Jamshed Iqbal

mcqs.question: What is the atomic number (number of protons) of Carbon?
mcqs.explanation: Carbon has an atomic number of 6, meaning it has 6 protons in its nucleus. Its standard atomic mass is approximately 12.011 amu.
mcqs.reference: Periodic Table Basics / FPSC & PPSC Chemistry
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: What is the pH value of pure neutral water at standard room temperature (25°C)?
mcqs.explanation: Pure water has an equal concentration of hydrogen [H+] and hydroxide [OH-] ions, giving it a neutral pH of exactly 7 at 25°C.
mcqs.reference: Acids and Bases / General Science Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: The horizontal rows in the Modern Periodic Table of elements are called:
mcqs.explanation: The horizontal rows of the periodic table are called Periods (7 periods in total), while the vertical columns are called Groups (18 groups).
mcqs.reference: Modern Periodic Law / PPSC Chemistry Lecturer
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: Which gas is released when dilute hydrochloric acid (HCl) reacts with zinc (Zn) metal granules?
mcqs.explanation: Zn + 2HCl -> ZnCl2 + H2. Active metals react with dilute acids to displace and evolve Hydrogen gas, verified by a pop sound test.
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: Which chemical element is the most electronegative in the entire periodic table?
mcqs.explanation: Fluorine has the highest electronegativity value of 3.98 on the Pauling scale, possessing the strongest tendency to attract shared electrons.
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: What is the chemical molecular formula of Ozone, which absorbs harmful ultraviolet radiation in the stratosphere?
mcqs.explanation: Ozone is a triatomic allotrope of oxygen with the chemical formula O3.
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: A chemical bond formed by the mutual sharing of one or more pairs of electrons between two atoms is called a:
mcqs.explanation: A covalent bond forms when two non-metal atoms share valence electron pairs to attain stable inert gas electronic configurations.
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: Dry Ice is the solid frozen state of which chemical compound?
mcqs.explanation: Dry ice is solid Carbon Dioxide (CO2) at -78.5°C (-109.3°F), which sublimes directly into gas without melting into liquid.
mcqs.reference: Physical Chemistry / PPSC Most Repeated Questions
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: What is the chemical name of common Baking Soda (NaHCO3)?
mcqs.explanation: Baking soda is Sodium Bicarbonate or Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate with formula NaHCO3. Washing soda is Na2CO3·10H2O.
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: In thermodynamics, a chemical reaction that releases heat energy into its surroundings (ΔH is negative) is called an:
mcqs.explanation: Exothermic reactions release thermal energy into surroundings causing temperature rise (e.g. combustion). Endothermic reactions absorb heat.
mcqs.subject: Chemistry MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Naveed Akhtar

mcqs.question: Which cellular organelle is universally referred to as the "Powerhouse of the Cell"?
mcqs.explanation: Mitochondria generate cellular energy in the form of ATP (adenosine triphosphate) through cellular aerobic respiration.
mcqs.reference: Cell Biology / FPSC & PPSC Past Papers
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: How many total chromosomes (or pairs) are present in the somatic body cells of a normal human being?
mcqs.explanation: Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes (46 chromosomes in total in somatic diploid cells): 22 pairs of autosomes and 1 pair of sex chromosomes (XX or XY).
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: Which ABO and Rh blood group is designated as the "Universal Red Blood Cell Donor"?
mcqs.explanation: O Negative (O-) red blood cells have neither A, B, nor Rh antigens on their surface, so they can safely be transfused to patients of any blood type.
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: Which iron-containing protein pigment gives red color to human erythrocytes (red blood cells) and binds oxygen?
mcqs.explanation: Hemoglobin is an iron-rich protein in red blood cells that transports oxygen from the lungs to tissues throughout the body.
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: Bile juice, essential for the emulsification and digestion of fats, is synthesized and secreted by which organ?
mcqs.explanation: Bile is produced by the Liver and stored/concentrated in the Gallbladder before being released into the duodenum.
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: What is the fundamental structural and functional communication unit of the human nervous system?
mcqs.explanation: The Neuron is the basic cellular building block of the nervous system that transmits electrical nerve impulses. (Nephron is the unit of kidney).
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: Which chamber of the human heart possesses the thickest muscular wall to pump oxygenated blood into the systemic aorta?
mcqs.explanation: The Left Ventricle has the thickest myocardium because it must generate enough hydraulic pressure to pump blood throughout the entire systemic circulation.
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: The biological loss of water in the form of vapor through microscopic stomata in plant leaves is known as:
mcqs.explanation: Transpiration is the evaporation of water from plant leaves through stomata, generating the transpirational pull for sap ascent.
mcqs.reference: Plant Physiology / PPSC Botany & General Science
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: Which digestive enzyme present in human saliva initiates the biochemical breakdown of starch into maltose sugars?
mcqs.explanation: Salivary Amylase (historically called Ptyalin) breaks down dietary starches into simpler disaccharide sugars right inside the oral cavity.
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: The world’s first life-saving antibiotic drug, Penicillin, was discovered in 1928 by Scottish bacteriologist:
mcqs.explanation: Sir Alexander Fleming discovered Penicillin from the mold Penicillium notatum in 1928, revolutionizing modern medicine and infectious disease treatment.
mcqs.reference: History of Medicine / PPSC Most Repeated Questions
mcqs.subject: Biology MCQs
mcqs.author: Dr. Fatima Zahra

mcqs.question: The central Inter Services Selection Board (ISSB) headquarters is located in which city of Pakistan?
mcqs.explanation: ISSB Headquarters is situated in Kohat (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa), with regional testing centers operating at Gujranwala, Malir (Karachi), and Quetta.
mcqs.reference: ISSB Official / Armed Forces Recruitment Tests
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: What is the highest military gallantry award in the armed forces of Pakistan?
mcqs.explanation: Nishan-e-Haider (Emblem of Haider) is Pakistan’s highest military decoration awarded posthumously to members of the armed forces for acts of extraordinary valor.
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: Who was the very first recipient of Nishan-e-Haider in Pakistan military history?
mcqs.explanation: Captain Muhammad Sarwar Shaheed was awarded the first Nishan-e-Haider for his supreme sacrifice during the Kashmir War at Tilpatra on 27 July 1948.
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: The Air Headquarters (AHQ) of Pakistan Air Force (PAF) is located in which city?
mcqs.explanation: Air Headquarters (AHQ) of PAF and Naval Headquarters (NHQ) are located in Sector E-9, Islamabad. General Headquarters (GHQ) is in Rawalpindi.
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: What is the official operational motto of the Pakistan Army?
mcqs.explanation: The motto of the Pakistan Army is "Imaan, Taqwa, Jihad fi Sabilillah" (Faith, Piety, and Striving in the Path of Allah), established in 1950.
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: What is the military rank of the Chief of Army Staff (COAS) in the Pakistan Army?
mcqs.explanation: The Chief of Army Staff (COAS) holds the rank of a Four-Star General in the Pakistan Army.
mcqs.reference: Armed Forces Rank Structure / ISSB Initial Test
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: Which officer rank in the Pakistan Navy is directly equivalent to the rank of Major in the Pakistan Army?
mcqs.explanation: In the trilateral armed forces rank structure: Major (Army) = Lieutenant Commander (Navy) = Squadron Leader (Air Force).
mcqs.reference: Armed Forces Equivalent Ranks / ISSB Guide
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: The premier officer cadet training institution of the Pakistan Army, PMA Kakul, is located near which city?
mcqs.explanation: Pakistan Military Academy (PMA) is situated at Kakul near Abbottabad in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, founded in October 1947.
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: Which advanced multirole fighter aircraft is jointly developed and produced by Pakistan Aeronautical Complex (PAC) Kamra and CAC China?
mcqs.explanation: The JF-17 Thunder (FC-1 Xiaolong) is a lightweight, single-engine, multirole combat aircraft jointly designed and produced by PAC Kamra and CAC.
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: What is the name of Pakistan Navy’s elite Special Operations maritime commando force?
mcqs.explanation: Special Service Group Navy (SSGN), established in 1966 with SEAL training, is the premier maritime special operations and counter-terrorism force of Pakistan Navy.
mcqs.subject: Army, Navy & Air Force
mcqs.author: Major (R) Asad Qureshi

mcqs.question: اردو زبان کے پہلے باقاعدہ صاحبِ دیوان شاعر کون تسلیم کیے جاتے ہیں؟
mcqs.explanation: سلطان محمد قلی قطب شاہ (فرمانروائے گولکنڈہ) اردو کے پہلے صاحبِ دیوان شاعر تسلیم کیے جاتے ہیں۔ ولی دکنی کو اردو غزل کا بابا آدم کہا جاتا ہے۔
mcqs.reference: تاریخِ ادبِ اردو / پی پی ایس سی لیکچرر اردو
mcqs.subject: Urdu MCQs
mcqs.author: پروفیسر ڈاکٹر طاہر فاروقی

mcqs.question: مولانا الطاف حسین حالی کی شہرۂ آفاق طویل نظم "مسدسِ حالی" کا اصل اور تاریخی نام کیا ہے؟
mcqs.explanation: مولانا الطاف حسین حالی نے یہ طویل نظم 1879ء میں سرسید احمد خان کی فرمائش پر لکھی جس کا اصل نام "مد و جزرِ اسلام" تھا جو بعد میں مسدس حالی کے نام سے مشہور ہوئی۔
mcqs.reference: پی پی ایس سی و ایف پی ایس سی اردو پرچے
mcqs.subject: Urdu MCQs
mcqs.author: پروفیسر ڈاکٹر طاہر فاروقی

mcqs.question: فورٹ ولیم کالج کلکتہ کے تحت لکھی گئی مشہور کتاب "باغ و بہار" کے مصنف کون ہیں؟
mcqs.explanation: میر امن دہلوی نے امیر خسرو کی فارسی داستان "قصہ چہار درویش" کو سلیس اور بامحاورہ اردو میں ترجمہ کر کے "باغ و بہار" کے نام سے 1802ء میں پیش کیا۔
mcqs.reference: فورٹ ولیم کالج ادب / پی پی ایس سی اسسٹنٹ ڈائریکٹر
mcqs.subject: Urdu MCQs
mcqs.author: پروفیسر ڈاکٹر طاہر فاروقی

mcqs.question: اردو زبان و ادب میں کس عظیم ادبی شخصیت کو "بابائے اردو" کے لقب سے یاد کیا جاتا ہے؟
mcqs.explanation: انجمن ترقی اردو کے بانی اور اردو کی ترویج و اشاعت کے عظیم رہنما مولوی عبدالحق (1870ء - 1961ء) کو بابائے اردو کہا جاتا ہے۔
mcqs.reference: مشاہیر ادب / ایف پی ایس سی و پی پی ایس سی

mcqs.question: شاعرِ مشرق علامہ محمد اقبال کا پہلا اردو شعری مجموعہ کون سا ہے جو 1924ء میں شائع ہوا؟
mcqs.explanation: علامہ اقبال کا پہلا اردو شعری مجموعہ "بانگِ درا" 1924ء میں شائع ہوا۔ اس کے بعد بالِ جبریل (1935ء)، ضربِ کلیم (1936ء) اور ارمغانِ حجاز (1938ء) منظرِ عام پر آئے۔
mcqs.reference: کلیاتِ اقبال / پی پی ایس سی اردو پرچہ جات
mcqs.subject: Urdu MCQs
mcqs.author: پروفیسر ڈاکٹر طاہر فاروقی

mcqs.question: اردو کے معروف تذکرہ نگار اور انشا پرداز مولانا محمد حسین آزاد کی کتاب "آبِ حیات" بنیادی طور پر کس موضوع پر ہے؟

options.text: شعرائے اردو کی تاریخ اور تذکرہ

mcqs.explanation: "آبِ حیات" (شائع شدہ 1880ء) اردو شعرا کی مستند تاریخ اور پانچ ادبی ادوار کا شاہکار تذکرہ ہے جس نے اردو تنقید و تاریخ نویسی کی بنیاد رکھی۔
mcqs.reference: تاریخ نقد و ادب / سی ایس ایس اردو ادب

mcqs.author: پروفیسر ڈاکٹر طاہر فاروقی

mcqs.question: اردو کلاسیکی شاعری میں "خدائے سخن" اور "شہنشاہِ غزل" کس عظیم شاعر کو کہا جاتا ہے؟
mcqs.explanation: میر تقی میر (1723ء - 1810ء) کو ان کے کمالِ تغزل اور غم و اندوہ کی ترجمانی کی بدولت "خدائے سخن" تسلیم کیا جاتا ہے۔
mcqs.reference: کلاسیکی اردو شاعری / پی پی ایس سی Past Papers

mcqs.author: پروفیسر ڈاکٹر طاہر فاروقی

mcqs.question: مرزا اسد اللہ خان غالب کس آخری مغل فرماں روا کے باقاعدہ استادِ سخن مقرر ہوئے تھے؟
mcqs.explanation: شیخ ابراہیم ذوق کے انتقال (1854ء) کے بعد آخری مغل بادشاہ بہادر شاہ ظفر نے مرزا اسد اللہ خان غالب کو اپنا استادِ شاعری مقرر کیا اور نجم الدولہ، دبیر الملک، نظام جنگ کا خطاب دیا۔
mcqs.reference: حیاتِ غالب / پی پی ایس سی امتحانات
mcqs.subject: Urdu MCQs
mcqs.author: پروفیسر ڈاکٹر طاہر فاروقی

mcqs.question: "نقشِ فریادی" اور "دستِ صبا" کس نامور انقلابی و ترقی پسند شاعر کے شعری مجموعے ہیں؟
mcqs.explanation: "نقشِ فریادی" (1941ء) فیض احمد فیض کا پہلا شعری مجموعہ تھا جبکہ "دستِ صبا" دورانِ اسیری (حیدرآباد جیل) تحریر کیا گیا۔ فیض کو لینن امن انعام سے بھی نوازا گیا۔
mcqs.reference: ترقی پسند شاعری / سی ایس ایس اردو اختیاری
mcqs.subject: Urdu MCQs
mcqs.author: پروفیسر ڈاکٹر طاہر فاروقی

mcqs.question: اردو قواعد (گرامر) کی رو سے وہ کلمہ جو کسی شخص، جگہ، چیز یا کیفیت کے نام کو ظاہر کرے کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
mcqs.explanation: وہ بامعنی لفظ جو کسی بھی جاندار، بے جان، جگہ یا کیفیت کا نام ہو اسے قواعد میں "اسم" (Noun) کہتے ہیں، جیسے احمد، لاہور، کتاب، خوشی۔
mcqs.reference: اردو قواعد و انشا / پی پی ایس سی ایجوکیٹرز ٹیسٹ

blogPosts.title: Top 100 Most Repeated Prepositions in PPSC & FPSC Exams
blogPosts.summary: Master fixed prepositions like "Senior to", "Abide by", "Accused of", and "Conform to" to score 100% in English sections.
blogPosts.content:
# 100 Most Repeated Prepositions in Competitive Exams

Fixed prepositions form the core of English MCQs in PPSC, FPSC, NTS, and CSS exams.

### 10 Critical Preposition Rules:
1. **Senior / Junior / Superior**: Always use **TO** (e.g., He is senior to me).
2. **Abide**: Use **BY** (e.g., You must abide by the rules).
3. **Accused**: Use **OF** (e.g., He was accused of theft).
4. **Prevent**: Use **FROM** (e.g., Prevented him from going).
5. **Comply**: Use **WITH** (e.g., Comply with regulations).
